lines.zh: 我拖着壳，从泥里爬上草地。
lines.en: I haul my shell out of the mud onto grass.

lines.zh: 每走一步，腹甲都磕一下。
lines.en: Every step knocks my plastron against the ground.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水太凉，我要晒背。
lines.en: The swamp water is cold; I need sun on my shell.
I go around the roots instead of over them.
The grass stands a little taller than my shell.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，但方向没错。
lines.en: I walk slowly, but my direction is right.
Mud squeezes out from the seams of my shell.
Ahead lies a stone warmed by the sun.
I hear the water sounding behind me.
I lift a foot the way one lifts a brick.

lines.zh: 雾还压在芦苇上，散不开。
lines.en: Mist still lies on the reeds and will not lift.
I follow a fallen log; it costs less effort.
My shell is heavy; I brake going downhill.

lines.zh: 我爬到高处，只为晒一会儿。
lines.en: I climb up only to sun myself a while.

lines.zh: 我从芦苇丛里挤出去，壳上挂草。
lines.en: I squeeze from the reeds, grass on my shell.

lines.zh: 上坡很吃力，我把爪子全伸出来。
lines.en: Uphill is hard; I stretch out every claw.

lines.zh: 泥太滑，我滑回原地又爬。
lines.en: Mud is slick; I slide back and climb again.

lines.zh: 我在水边绕了一圈，找浅处。
lines.en: I circle the water's edge looking for shallows.
I pull my head in and listen to the wind.

lines.zh: 壳上有苔，我不打算清理。
lines.en: Moss grows on my shell; I will not clean it.

lines.zh: 沼泽的气泡一个接一个破。
lines.en: The swamp's bubbles break one after another.
Half-lidded, I watch the reeds sway.
Sunning my shell matters more than eating.

lines.zh: 我在壳里数自己的心跳。
lines.en: Inside my shell I count my own heartbeat.

lines.zh: 有只青蛙跳上了我的背。
lines.en: A frog has climbed onto my back.
I stay still, and it stops being afraid.
Drying mud cracks like an old wall.
I stretch my legs and sun my belly.
I have used this fallen log for three years.
Everything is blurred in the mist.
I open my mouth for a long, slow yawn.

lines.zh: 壳里的味道只有我自己懂。
lines.en: Only I understand the smell inside my shell.

lines.zh: 我闭眼听着水面上的虫声。
lines.en: Eyes shut, I listen to insects on the water.

lines.zh: 我把下巴搁在石头上，慢慢眨。
lines.en: Chin on a stone, I blink slowly.

lines.zh: 你跪在泥里，我们差不多高。
lines.en: You kneel in the mud; we are nearly the same height.
I poke my head out to look at you.

lines.zh: 你站的位置，正好挡住晒背的太阳。
lines.en: You are standing right where my sunning light was.
I know the bucket at your hip.
Will you flip me over, or only look?
I tilt my head; my shell tilts with it.
Your boots are covered in swamp mud.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手指，慢慢眨。
lines.en: I watch your fingers and blink slowly.
I can tell you are thinking of soup.

lines.zh: 我往前挪了一寸，然后停住。
lines.en: I shuffle an inch forward, then stop.
Your breath moves the reeds.

lines.zh: 我不是怕你，是懒得挪这身壳。
lines.en: I am not afraid; I just will not move this shell.

lines.zh: 壳被敲了一下，声音发闷。
lines.en: My shell is struck; the sound is dull.
I pull in, legs still trembling.
A crack spreads from the middle of my back.
It hurts, but I can still walk.
Your weapon is heavier than stone.

lines.zh: 被掀翻了，我用脖子顶回来。
lines.en: Knocked on my back, I push up with my neck.
Blood seeps out between the plates.
I bite air and retreat into the reeds.
Not a second blow; I cannot take it.

lines.zh: 我活着靠的就是这层壳。
lines.en: This shell is what keeps me alive.
Is that a mushroom, or a rotten berry?
I smell sweetness and stretch my neck.
There is so little to eat in this swamp.
I shuffle half a step toward your hand.
Hold still; I cannot see it clearly.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，又想到壳外的世界。
lines.en: I open my mouth, then think of the world outside.
This smells better than a snail.

lines.zh: 我的前爪已经搭上来了。
lines.en: My front claw is already resting on it.
As long as it is not hot, I will eat.
I take a bite and chew very slowly.

lines.zh: 你手里的比我找到的好。
lines.en: What you hold beats what I forage.

lines.zh: 我跟着你走了几步，忘了晒背。
lines.en: I follow you a few steps, forgetting the sun.
I do not quite trust this smell.
Give me a little more, then I return to the swamp.
Worms? They still smell of soil.

lines.zh: 我闻了两下，才伸出脖子。
lines.en: I sniff twice before stretching my neck.

lines.zh: 这一推，我壳在泥上打了个转。
lines.en: That shove spins my shell around in the mud.

lines.zh: 你的脚碰到壳，声音很闷。
lines.en: Your foot hits my shell with a dull sound.

lines.zh: 我缩进去，等这一下过去。
lines.en: I pull in and wait for it to pass.
The shell took it; I am fine.
You nearly kick me onto my back.
I slide into the mud and steady myself.
Whatever hit me is harder than stone.
I brace all four legs and push back.
The impact splashes water onto the reeds.
Do not shove; it is soft under this shell.
Only the two of us are left in this swamp.
I tap its shell lightly with my head.
It stays withdrawn, and so do I.

lines.zh: 我们并排晒背，谁也不挤。
lines.en: We sun side by side, neither crowding.
I dug the mud hollow first.

lines.zh: 它的壳比我旧，花纹更深。
lines.en: Its shell is older, the pattern deeper.

lines.zh: 我们绕着倒木走了一圈。
lines.en: We circle the fallen log once together.
The eggs go into soft mud; leave them.
I guard the hollow and drive the crabs off.

lines.zh: 慢一点，我们有的是时间。
lines.en: Slowly; we have all the time there is.

lines.zh: 我被拎起来，四条腿空蹬。
lines.en: Lifted up, my four legs paddle nothing.
Your hand cups my plastron.

lines.zh: 壳朝下我头晕，快翻过来。
lines.en: Upside down I reel; turn me back.
I withdraw, leaving only my snout out.
Are you taking me away from the swamp?
I hear your heartbeat very close.

lines.zh: 别摇，我壳里的东西会晃。
lines.en: Do not shake me; things in my shell rattle.
I have never been this high before.

lines.zh: 你手上的泥味，我记住了。
lines.en: The mud smell on your hands; I will remember it.
Put me down; the grass is soft.
Something is moving beyond the reeds.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，脖子伸到最长。
lines.en: I raise my head, neck stretched full length.
A muffled thud comes through the mud.
Not a frog; frogs are lighter.
I turn slowly toward the noise.
This swamp rarely has visitors.
I lower my head flat against the mud.
A shadow covers my shell.
I hear it, but I do not move yet.
If it comes closer, I withdraw.
I fix on that shadow without moving.
When it moves, my head follows.
I count how many shell-lengths away it is.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水面把声音放大。
lines.en: The swamp water magnifies the sound.
I draw my legs in against the shell.
It circles; I do not.
I stay drawn in and wait for it to reach first.
My heartbeat slows, which suits me.
At this distance it needs one step.
I bite a reed stem to steady myself.
I bite its ankle and fail to break skin.
I ram with my shell, like a stone.

lines.zh: 顶出去一下，我壳也退半寸。
lines.en: One ram, and my own shell slides back an inch.

lines.zh: 我只有嘴和壳，都用上了。
lines.en: My mouth and shell are all I have; both used.
It kicks; I clamp down and hold.
I bite mud; sand fills my teeth.
Slow as I am, I do not retreat.

lines.zh: 我撞它的小腿，声音很响。
lines.en: I butt its shin; the sound is loud.
This shell is hard enough to block once.
When it is over I leave, back to the mud.

lines.zh: 我从沼泽的浅水里钻出来。
lines.en: I climb out of the swamp's shallow water.

lines.zh: 刚出水，壳缝里全是水草。
lines.en: Just out of the water, weeds fill every seam.
The mist is low, sliding over the water.

lines.zh: 我闻到泥和腐叶的味道。
lines.en: I smell mud and rotting leaves.
This is a good place to live slowly.
First I find dry ground to sun my shell.
The reeds block most of my view.
I hear frogs calling in the distance.
Two box turtles, each going its own way.
I decide there is no hurry today.

lines.zh: 壳被烤得发烫，我只能往里缩。
lines.en: The shell heats up; I can only shrink inward.

lines.zh: 摔下去时，背甲先磕到石头。
lines.en: I fall and the back of my shell hits stone first.

lines.zh: 我在水里太久，头开始发沉。
lines.en: Too long underwater, my head grows heavy.

lines.zh: 爆炸的气浪把我推得直打滑。
lines.en: The blast wave shoves me sliding across the mud.
An arrow sticks in the pattern of my back.
Light grazes my shell and leaves a chill.

lines.zh: 沼泽里的果子早被我吃光。
lines.en: I ate the swamp's berries long ago.

lines.zh: 雷打中倒木，我壳都震了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the log; my shell shakes.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有泥，我抓不住。
lines.en: There is no mud in the void to grip.
